alterations.description: Reduce fights and indiscriminate shooting, omitting particularly the low stomach punch on the hold-man.

Drastically reduce the sequences of bank-robbery by the 'Kobat', omitting all the scenes of forcing open the door, gate and the vault. Merely show the mechanical man entering the building and leaving it with bag containing gold and inside the bank show the watchman watching him going out of the gate, firing at him and being attacked by him and then raising the alarm.
